isAdmin.description: Whether the user is an Admin (is an AppAdmin, EnvAdmin, or ClusterAdmin)

isDataDisclosureAdmin.description: Whether the user can approve / deny download and sharing requests

isPowerEditor.description: Whether the user is an editor exempt from going through the approval flow for download and sharing data

isLimitedEditor.description: Whether the user is an editor that needs to go through approval flow for download and sharing data

isEditor.description: Whether the user is any type of editor (Power Editor or Limited Editor)

isViewer.description: Whether the member is a Viewer in a Team account

isCollaborator.description: Whether the member is an Editor or a Viewer in a Team account

isNewUser.description: True if the user does not own any Visual Notebook

title:
Information about an {@link ExMachinaUser} and the linked {@link ExMachinaAccount} to help determine what
the user should be able to access. Used by {@link ExMachinaUser.userInfo}.
name: ExMachinaUserInfo
